label: The word 'convertible' / 'convertibles' (noun or adjective) in any sense: the open-top car, a sofa or bed that converts, convertible bonds, notes or shares, a convertible seat or stroller. It is weak when an adverb sits right before it ('fully convertible', 'freely convertible'), so fire cases have no adverb there. Quiet: other '-ible' words (compatible, reversible, collectibles, deductible), 'convert', 'converted', 'conversion', and open-top cars described without the word (roadster, cabriolet, 'top down'). Left out of this test: Spanish, French and Portuguese words starting with 'vari-' (e.g. variedad, variété) and the word 'invaluable' also fire.
